QUARTERLY OPERATIONS SUMMARY

1. Overview

The operations team completed the migration of the warehouse inventory
system during the third quarter. All stock records were reconciled and the
legacy database was retired at the end of September.

2. Key figures

  - Orders processed: 18 240
  - Average dispatch time: 1.8 days
  - Returns rate: 2.1 %

3. Next steps

The team will focus on automating the replenishment process and on
improving the accuracy of demand forecasts. Pilot results are expected
in the first quarter of next year.

Latviešu valodā: Ražošanas apjomi ir pieauguši, un šīs pārmaiņas ietekmē
gan ražību, gan vides ilgtspēju. Ģimenes saimniecības – ķīmija, ļoti, ņemot.
